parsed.scene_description: The image shows a large warehouse with multiple stacks of metal cages. The cages are stacked on top of each other and are arranged in a neat and orderly manner. In the center of the image, there is an orange forklift truck parked in front of one of the cages. On the right side of the forklift, there are several stacks of cardboard boxes and pallets. The warehouse appears to be well-stocked with various tools and equipment. The floor is made of concrete and there are large windows on the left side, allowing natural light to enter the space.
